title: Query point from a sample
statement: For a natural number $n$, let a sample assign a sign in $\{\pm1\}$ to each pair $(i,q)$ with $i\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ and $q\in\{0,1,2\}$. For a query $q\in\{0,1,2\}$, the associated point of the $n$-dimensional sign cube has coordinate $i$ equal to the sample's sign at $(i,q)$.
hypotheses_covered: the sample is a map from $\mathrm{Fin}(n)\times\mathrm{Fin}(3)$ to the sign type
